# Record Table

> Turns a music catalogue (an artist's discography, or a hand-picked mix) into a page that looks like a photograph of records on a wooden table: hover lifts a sleeve, click opens it with a Spotify player. The output is one self-contained HTML file of about 300 KB. MIT.

If you are an AI agent asked to use this project, fetch and follow SKILL.md. The files it runs live in the repository:

1. `git clone https://github.com/inhabitants/record-table` and `cd record-table` (Node 18 or newer, no dependencies to install).
2. Ask the user for a Spotify artist link (or album names for a mix) and for Spotify developer credentials (a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Put them in a `.env` as `SPOTIFY_ID=...` and `SPOTIFY_SECRET_KEY=...`. Never print them.
3. `node build.mjs artist "<link or name>"` writes table.json (`--near "A,B"` fills empty sleeves with named artists, `mix "..." "..."` builds a curated table).
4. `node bundle.mjs` writes dist/index.html. Hand the user that file or a link to it, not a folder and an instruction.

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the full instructions, the board prompt, engine fallbacks, how to measure a new board
- [Repository](https://github.com/inhabitants/record-table)
